review: Privacy charter decision D4. Shown unchecked in onboarding's inbox step; none is contacted until the user picks it and confirms. Each relay was checked on the review date with an unauthenticated REQ for kind 1059 addressed to a random pubkey (the same probe Groundhog runs after confirmation) and its NIP-11 document. private_reads is 'yes' only when that REQ was refused as auth-required, 'no' when it was answered, and 'unknown' when it was not checked; Groundhog re-checks after the user confirms and shows the live result. Relays that answered such reads without sign-in, charge for use, or could not be reached on the review date are left out. Keep this list short, and re-review every entry before changing it.

relays.name: nostr.net
relays.description: A general public relay run by nostr.net. It can also hold your published settings.
relays.evidence: 2026-09-28: REQ {kinds:[1059]} closed with 'auth-required: requested filter requires authentication'; NIP-11: strfry, free, lists NIP-59.

relays.name: nostr1 inbox
relays.description: A free relay made for private messages. Its operator describes it as test (alpha) software.
relays.evidence: 2026-09-28: REQ {kinds:[1059]} closed with 'auth-required: you must auth'; NIP-11: strfry, auth_required true, payment_required false, 'free DM Inbox Relay running alpha software'.

relays.name: NIP-17 relay
relays.description: Stores only private messages, so it can't hold your published settings. Choose it together with another relay.
relays.evidence: 2026-09-28: REQ {kinds:[1059]} closed with 'auth-required: you must authenticate first'; NIP-11: 'We only accept kind 1059 events', lists NIP-17, NIP-42, NIP-59.
